records.heading: Records
records.editedHint: Manually edited records are lost when the import is converted again.

search.label: Search records by title or AVefi PID
search.hint: The search covers every record of this import, not just the page on screen.

table.caption: Generated AVefi works with year, work type, PID, number of manifestations and items, and completeness
table.title: Title
table.coreComplete: All four core fields are filled.

empty.heading: No records yet
empty.text: This import has not been converted yet, or it produced no works.

records.note: Completeness is the share of filled required and recommended fields. Red below 50 %, amber below 80 %, green from 80 %.

editor.saved: Saved. The record is now marked as edited by hand.
editor.leave: This record has unsaved changes. Leave the page anyway?
editor.jsonHint: This is what the form holds right now, not what is stored.
editor.pidText: Persistent identifiers are assigned by AVefi at a later stage. This tool lets you record an existing PID, but it cannot mint a new one.

check.heading: Validation against the AVefi schema
check.explain: Validation runs on the server with the same checker used during conversion.
check.ok: No findings. The record conforms to the AVefi schema.
check.unavailable: The validation service could not be reached ({reason}). Nothing was validated — which is not the same as “fine”.
check.saveAnyway: Saving stays possible: work in progress may be stored.
check.hintsExplain: Not errors — the record can be saved and delivered without them.

editor.schemaMissing: The AVefi schema value lists could not be loaded. The affected fields accept free text so that work can continue: {reason}

enum.empty: Value list unavailable — please type the value.
enum.unknownValue: “{value}” is not in the value list.

work.makePrimaryHint: Swaps this title with the primary one. A further title never becomes the primary title by itself.
work.subjectsHint: Type and pick a match. A confirmed match is attached as same_as and never replaces the name.
work.matchResult: {hit} of {total} entries matched unambiguously. Ambiguous ones stay without an identifier and are offered for selection.
work.matchNone: There is no entry without an identifier that could be matched.
work.activitiesHint: Activity, role and person. The person can be linked to GND, Wikidata or VIAF.
work.identifierPattern: “{value}” does not match the pattern of this identifier type.

manifestation.heading: Manifestation {index}
manifestation.title: Title of the manifestation
manifestation.empty: No manifestation is recorded for this work.
manifestation.kept: Fields this editor does not show are preserved on save.

item.heading: Item {index}
item.title: Title of the item
item.empty: No item is recorded for this work.

authority.ambiguous: Several equally good matches — please choose yourself. Nothing was entered.
authority.detailNone: There is no further description for this identifier.

structure.lead: An item belongs to exactly one manifestation, so items are listed underneath theirs.
structure.orphanLead: The source file does not say which manifestation these items belong to. They stay unassigned until someone decides.

error.record_not_found: This record does not exist (any more). The import may have been converted again in the meantime.
error.record_malformed: The record could not be read. Please reload the page and repeat the change.
error.record_no_work: Without a work there is no record. Please fill in at least the work data.
error.paging_invalid: The paging parameter was invalid. Showing the first page again.
error.authority_no_source: The AVefi schema allows no authority source for kind “{kind}”. The name can still be entered.
error.authority_failed: The authority search failed. The name can still be entered and linked later.
error.unauthorized: The session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission for this step.
error.network: The server could not be reached. The changes in the form are still there — please save again.
error.unexpected: Unexpected error ({status}). Please repeat the action.
